paragraphs.text: According to Jacob's prophecy that he would be scattered among the other tribes.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: within the inheritance of the children

paragraphs.text: But this large portion was given them by God's providence to declare their increase in time to come.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Or, westward, toward the great sea.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: There was another Bethlehem in the tribe of Judah.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: There was another city of this name in the tribe of Judah: for in various tribes certain cities had the same name, and were distinguished by the tribe only.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Joins to the tribe of Zebulun, which lay more to the east.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Which was Zoar, a strong city at the sea.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: These cities were in the country of Zaanannim.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Of which the lake of Gennesaret had its name.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: According as Jacob had prophesied in Ge 49:17.
